options: Observe or use evidence, connect it to the concept, and explain the conclusion.

items.question: Explain solid liquid gas and give one everyday example.
items.answer: A strong answer gives an accurate explanation and a relevant example.

flashcards.back: Define solid liquid gas, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define melting and freezing, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define evaporation and condensation, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define water cycle, give an example, and explain why it matters.

interactive_activities.title: Explore solid liquid gas
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on solid liquid gas. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where melting and freezing is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach water cycle to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
